import numpy as np
from scipy import stats

MAX_DRIVERS = 4

def design(feats):
    # Filter to expression and clinical features
    expr_clin_ids = [fid for fid, typ in zip(feats.ids, feats.types) 
                     if typ in ('expression', 'clinical')]
    
    # Remove near-duplicates based on correlations
    keep_ids = set(expr_clin_ids)
    correlated_pairs = [(a,b,r) for a,b,r in [
        ('UKIG4','RHH16',0.96), ('UKIG4','MBPM16L',0.94), ('UKIG4','GDVD19',-0.94),
        ('EHJ3','UKIG4',0.92), ('KXS1P','CON18P',0.92), ('UKIG4','XRD6',-0.90),
        ('UKIG4','HPUN5',-0.90), ('RHH16','GDVD19',-0.89), ('XRD6','DZYB2',0.89),
        ('MBPM16L','RHH16',0.89), ('MBPM16L','GDVD19',-0.88), ('RHH16','HPUN5',-0.88),
        ('EHJ3','RHH16',0.88), ('UKIG4','SFOM7L',-0.88), ('KZZ10','GDVD19',0.87),
        ('XRD6','RHH16',-0.86), ('UKIG4','KXS1P',0.86), ('EHJ3','MBPM16L',0.86),
        ('EHJ3','GDVD19',-0.86), ('SFOM7L','RHH16',-0.85)
    ] if a in keep_ids and b in keep_ids]
    
    # Remove one from each correlated pair (keep first)
    for a, b, _ in correlated_pairs:
        if b in keep_ids:
            keep_ids.remove(b)
    
    expr_clin_ids = list(keep_ids)
    
    if not expr_clin_ids:
        return Design(drivers=(), columns=(), products=(), loadings={})
    
    # Compute t-statistics for each feature
    t_stats = []
    for fid in expr_clin_ids:
        col_idx = feats.column(fid)
        x = feats.x[:, col_idx]
        y = feats.y
        x1 = x[y == 1]
        x0 = x[y == 0]
        t, _ = stats.ttest_ind(x1, x0, equal_var=False)
        t_stats.append(abs(t))
    
    # Select top features by t-statistic
    sorted_indices = np.argsort(t_stats)[::-1][:MAX_DRIVERS]
    selected_ids = [expr_clin_ids[i] for i in sorted_indices]
    
    # Check if any features are significant
    if not selected_ids or max(t_stats) < 1.5:
        return Design(drivers=(), columns=(), products=(), loadings={})
    
    # Build design
    drivers = tuple(selected_ids[:len(selected_ids)])
    
    # For logistic regression, use all features
    columns = tuple(expr_clin_ids)
    
    # Add interaction terms for top features
    products = []
    for i in range(len(drivers)):
        for j in range(i+1, len(drivers)):
            products.append((drivers[i], drivers[j]))
    
    # Weighted score: sum of top features weighted by t-stat
    loadings = {}
    for i, fid in enumerate(selected_ids):
        col_idx = feats.column(fid)
        x = feats.x[:, col_idx]
        y = feats.y
        x1 = x[y == 1]
        x0 = x[y == 0]
        t, _ = stats.ttest_ind(x1, x0, equal_var=False)
        loadings[fid] = abs(t)
    
    return Design(drivers=drivers, columns=columns, products=tuple(products), loadings=loadings)
